doc: The Ledger by Lamplight — slot 3 of journeyman-everyday-2 (THR-1677).
Brief: `Docs/plans/encounters/journeyman-everyday-2-brief.md`.
plotHookRolled: hook.stronghold_raid, hook.sacred_crime, hook.assassination_succeeded
plotHookTaken:  hook.stronghold_raid — the stronghold is a counting house after dark,
and the raid takes nothing: one page, copied and put back. The other
two hooks were set aside (no sacred ground on an everyday board; no
killing in a journeyman copy job).
Seed Dice:      p3 opportunity (a season's wages for one page) · opposition faction
doctrine (the house's rule of the locked room: nobody after dark, a
clerk walks it twice a night, every seal checked at dawn) ·
disposition neutral (the house keeps its rule, it hunts nobody) ·
agent role trespasser · scale company (two houses and the town's watch)
─── The narrator's 12 questions, answered ───────────────────────────
1 P1 arrival?      Yes: `{actor}` is in `{location}` on the night its counting
houses close the quarter's books. Graph names only.
2 P2 events?       A rival house has already lost a contract to this one; its
factor offers a season's wages for one sealed page. Costs paid.
3 P3 one stake?    Opportunity: the purse, for one page copied unseen, against
the house's rule of the locked room.
4 ≤80 words?       Opening + step-0 spine: 76 words (critic pass).
5 Read aloud?      Every sentence is a report; no interior sensation.
6 Stated, never encoded? The rule is stated as a rule ('nobody enters the ledger
room after dark'), never implied by a locked door.
7 Every sentence works? Each is the challenge, the test, or the outcome.
8 Nothing unintroduced? The factor, the rule, the clerk's two walks, the press,
the seal and the dawn check appear before a card or chip names them.
9 One named person? Step 0: `{cast:factor}`. Step 1: `{cast:clerk}`.
10 Stake in a sentence? 'Can the sneak copy one sealed page without the counting
house ever knowing it was read?'
11 Cards verb+noun, spell-style? Yes; four specials, mechanism-stating, no
digits, no name word repeated in the effect line.
12 Opening per class? `urban`, the only declared class, written.
─── Mechanical design block (designed before the prose) ─────────────
Crux            A rival house pays for one page of a sealed ledger, copied and
put back. The counting house's rule of the locked room stands in
the way, and its seals are checked at dawn.
Whose problem?  The agent's: they took the purse and are the one inside the
room after dark (agentRole: trespasser).
Reach = theme?  Step 0 tests Shadow and is *about* getting in unseen between the
clerk's walks. Step 1 tests Shadow and is *about* leaving no trace:
lifting the seal, copying by one lamp, closing the press whole.
Difficulties 0.42 → 0.45 (brief; open-draw ceiling 0.45).
Shape           Seeded sequel. One placeless `encounter_seed` by query `#steal`
on step 1's success side (`inheritContext`, 96 ticks): when the
rival house wants another thing it should not have, its factor
sends for the mortal. `#steal` is the projected family 'something
to be taken that its keeper means to keep'; its urban members
(pickpocket, smuggle goods, shadow in the night, steal secrets,
vault heist) are the kind of work a paying house sends next. No
place-and-time promise anywhere (prose rule 7b).
Consequence hand (binding, THR-1145): `possession` + `place` — no swap.
`possession` — step 1 `successMetadata.rewardPool` (`#shadow`):
the factor pays the purse in kind, something for quiet work.
`place` — `apply_condition` `trait.condition.location.under_watch`
on `$here`, failure side: the dawn check finds a cracked seal, the
house knows its book was read, and the town sets a watch on its
counting houses. A fact about the town, and it makes the next
quiet job there harder (the condition's Shadow step modifier).
Extra           `bond_change` with `$cast:factor`, both directions: the paying
house trusts a clean copyist, and doubts one who was nearly caught.
Cool failure?   Nobody is hurt or jailed. The purse is not paid, the factor
trusts them less, and the town watches its counting houses.
Trait hooks     Gate: none (everyday by construction). Variant: none.
Trait-only nudge: none. Trait fragment: none.
Systems quota   cast + rewards + seeds + place conditions + bonds — five.
Heavy Hand      none authored (batch allowance left for other slots).

template.name: The Ledger by Lamplight

openings.urban: {actor} is in {location} on the night its biggest counting house closes the quarter's books.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
A rival house lost a contract to it and wants to know how. Its factor, {cast:factor}, will pay a season's wages for one page of the sealed ledger, copied and put back.

The counting house has a rule: nobody enters the ledger room after dark, and a clerk walks it twice a night. {actor} must get in unseen between the walks.
steps.successAfterimage: They were inside the ledger room before the second walk, and nobody saw them go in.
steps.failureAfterimage: They got in, but left a shutter unlatched, and the clerk will see it on the next walk.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: They got in unseen, but only by forcing a shutter that will not close again.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: They got in unseen and had the whole time between the walks to work.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The clerk saw a shadow at the shutter and doubled his walks. They are inside, with little time to work.

nudges.name: Smother The Lamps
nudges.effectLine: Put out every light along the house's street side, so nobody sees who stands at the shutter. A real help.

bandProse.success: The lamps on the street side went out together, and nobody saw the shutter open.
bandProse.failure: The lamps went out together, and the clerk came to the window to see why.

nudges.name: Stretch The Rounds
nudges.effectLine: Draw out the clerk's walk, so the gap between one pass and the next runs longer. A small help.

bandProse.critical_success: The clerk sat down at the far end of the house, and did not get up for a long while.
bandProse.failure: The clerk walked slower, and stopped by the ledger room door to rest.

steps.narrativeTemplate: The ledger lies in a locked press under the house's seal. {cast:clerk} will walk the room again within the hour. {actor} must lift the seal, copy the page by one lamp, and shut the press so nobody can tell it was opened. The house checks every seal at dawn.
steps.successAfterimage: They copied the page, set the seal back whole, and were gone before the clerk came round.
steps.failureAfterimage: They copied the page, but the seal cracked as they set it back, and the house found it at dawn.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: They set the seal back whole, but the clerk came early and half the page went uncopied.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: They copied the page and the one after it, and still set the seal back before the clerk came round.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The clerk walked in while the press stood open, and they ran with nothing copied.

effects.seedLabel: When the rival house wants another thing it should not have, its factor sends for the one who copied the page.

nudges.name: Spare The Seal
nudges.effectLine: Warm the wax under their knife, so it lifts in one piece and presses back without a mark. A real help.

bandProse.success: The wax came up whole and went back down whole.
bandProse.failure: The wax lifted cleanly, and cracked anyway when the press was shut too fast.

nudges.name: Clear The Head
nudges.effectLine: Hold the columns steady in their memory, so the figures go down right on the first pass. A real help.

bandProse.success: They copied the page once, without a blot, and had time to check it.
bandProse.success_at_cost: They copied fast and clean, and still ran out of time halfway down.
bandProse.failure: The figures went down right. It was the seal that went wrong.

narrativeTemplates.initiation: A rival house pays for one page of a counting house's sealed ledger, copied by lamplight and put back before the dawn check.
narrativeTemplates.success: The page was copied and the seal set back whole, and the factor who paid for it will send for the copyist again.
narrativeTemplates.failure: The house found its seal cracked at dawn, the purse went unpaid, and the town is watched now.

fallback.overview: One page of a sealed ledger was copied, or nearly, before the dawn check.

changes.detail: A night of quiet work teaches the shadow reach.

template.description: A two-step shadow job in a town counting house: get into the ledger room unseen between the night clerk's walks, then copy one sealed page by lamplight and close the press without a trace. A clean copy is paid in kind and the paying house's factor sends for the mortal again (a placeless seeded sequel by the #steal family); a cracked seal found at dawn leaves the town Under Watch and the purse unpaid.
